rationale: The workflow already implements the supported dependency-download cache optimization: Composer dependencies are cached with actions/cache using the composer.lock hash and a restore-key, matching P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, so adding an equivalent cache is contraindicated. Enabling fail-fast (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) would cancel remaining matrix jobs and reduce the intended coverage across multiple PHP versions and check types, and required-check policy is unverified, so it is not safe to apply. Cancel-superseded-runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) is contraindicated because the workflow runs on release/* branches (release work) and would require branch-partitioned concurrency. A custom job timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) lacks representative successful-duration history to set a safe limit. No supported, coverage-preserving change applies.
